/*getShoppintCartSelectSql_Kolo0016*/
SELECT (ROWNUM) NO, -- 00 Z.IMGFILE_NAME, -- 01 Z.IMGFILE_DIR, -- 02 Z.BUYER_ITEM_NO, -- 03 Z.DESCRIPTION_LOC, -- 04 Z.SPECIFICATION, -- 05 Z.ORIGIN_NAME, -- 06 Z.MAKER_NAME, -- 07 Z.UNIT_MEASURE, -- 08 Z.TARGET_PRICE, -- 09 Z.CATEGORY_NO, -- 10 DECODE(NVL(Z.AGENT,'MULTI'),'MULTI','복수공급사입니다','+','복수공급사입니다', DECODE((SELECT MAX(AGENT_OPEN_FLAG) FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = #{st_buyer} ) ,'N','코리아e플랫폼(주)', Z.AGENT)) AGENT, -- 11
Z.CART_QTY, -- 12 Z.TOT_SUM, -- 13 Z.STDCATEG_ID, -- 14 Z.CONTRACT_NO, -- 15 Z.CONTRACT_SEQ, -- 16 Z.BYIT_COMORG_CODE, -- 17 Z.REF_PR_NO, -- 18 Z.AGENT_CODE, -- 19 Z.BDGT_FLAG, -- 20 Z.ACCOUNT_TYPE, -- 21 Z.FIXED_PRICE_FLAG, -- 22 DECODE((SELECT MAX(AGENT_OPEN_FLAG) FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE com_code = #{st_buyer} ) ,'N','KRKORE0001', Z.AGENT_CODE) AGENT3, --23 Z.ACCOUNT_NAME, --24 Z.BUDGET_DEPT_CODE, --25 Z.BUDGET_DEPT_NAME, --26 Z.OVER_SHORT_FLAG, --27 Z.HS_NO, --28 Z.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG, --29 Z.REMARK, --30 Z.PROCESS_TYPE, --31 Z.STOCK_ITEM_FLAG --32 ,Z.HI_DEPT_CODE --33 ,Z.ITEM_STATUS_FLAG --34 삭제건 표기
FROM (SELECT ROWNUM NUM, Y.IMGFILE_NAME, Y.IMGFILE_DIR, Y.BUYER_ITEM_NO, Y.DESCRIPTION_LOC, Y.SPECIFICATION, Y.ORIGIN_NAME, Y.MAKER_NAME, Y.UNIT_MEASURE, Y.TARGET_PRICE, Y.CATEGORY_NO, Y.AGENT, Y.CART_QTY, Y.TOT_SUM, Y.STDCATEG_ID, Y.CONTRACT_NO, Y.CONTRACT_SEQ, Y.BYIT_COMORG_CODE, Y.REF_PR_NO, Y.AGENT_CODE, Y.BDGT_FLAG, Y.ACCOUNT_TYPE, Y.FIXED_PRICE_FLAG, Y.ACCOUNT_NAME, Y.BUDGET_DEPT_CODE, Y.BUDGET_DEPT_NAME, Y.OVER_SHORT_FLAG, Y.HS_NO, Y.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG, Y.REMARK, Y.PROCESS_TYPE , Y.STOCK_ITEM_FLAG ,Y.HI_DEPT_CODE ,Y.ITEM_STATUS_FLAG
FROM ( SELECT
TRIM(DECODE(SUBSTR(B.STDCATLG_ID,0,1),'M', (SELECT IMG_NAME FROM XPROIMGE WHERE IMG_NO = (SELECT DISTINCT IMG_NO FROM ITEMMAST WHERE STDCATLG_ID = B.STDCATLG_ID) AND RANKING = 1),B.IMGFILE_NAME)) AS IMGFILE_NAME, TRIM(DECODE(SUBSTR(B.STDCATLG_ID,0,1),'M', (SELECT IMG_DIR FROM XPROIMGE WHERE IMG_NO = (SELECT DISTINCT IMG_NO FROM ITEMMAST WHERE STDCATLG_ID = B.STDCATLG_ID) AND RANKING = 1),B.IMGFILE_DIR)) AS IMGFILE_DIR,
C.BUYER_ITEM_NO BUYER_ITEM_NO, C.DESCRIPTION DESCRIPTION_LOC, C.SPECIFICATION, (SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M001' AND CODE = C.ORIGIN_CODE) ORIGIN_NAME, C.MAKER_NAME, C.UNIT_MEASURE, DECODE(B.FIXED_PRICE_FLAG,'N',NVL(A.UNIT_PRICE,0),NVL(C.TARGET_PRICE,0)) TARGET_PRICE,
B.CATEGORY_NO, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE C.AGENT = COM_CODE) AS AGENT, DECODE(A.CART_QTY,'0','1',NVL(A.CART_QTY,1)) CART_QTY, (DECODE(A.CART_QTY,'0','1',NVL(A.CART_QTY,1)) * DECODE(B.FIXED_PRICE_FLAG,'N',NVL(A.UNIT_PRICE,0),NVL(C.TARGET_PRICE,0)) ) TOT_SUM,
B.STDCATEG_ID, C.CONTRACT_NO, C.CONTRACT_SEQ, A.BYIT_COMORG_CODE, A.REF_PR_NO, C.AGENT AS AGENT_CODE, (SELECT Z.FLAG FROM ICOMCOD2 Z WHERE Z.TYPE = 'Z014' AND Z.COMPANY_CODE = A.BUYER AND Z.CODE = B.ACCOUNT_TYPE) BDGT_FLAG, DECODE(A.ACCOUNT_TYPE,NULL,B.ACCOUNT_TYPE,A.ACCOUNT_TYPE) ACCOUNT_TYPE, B.FIXED_PRICE_FLAG FIXED_PRICE_FLAG,
(SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE COMPANY_CODE = A.BUYER AND TYPE = 'Z014' AND CODE = DECODE(A.ACCOUNT_TYPE,NULL,B.ACCOUNT_TYPE,A.ACCOUNT_TYPE)) AS ACCOUNT_NAME,
(select DECODE(COUNT(*),0 , '', 1 , DECODE(DECODE(A.BUDGET_DEPT,NULL,#{st_user_dept}, A.BUDGET_DEPT ),MAX(F.CODE1),MAX(F.CODE1),''), MAX((SELECT F.CODE1 FROM ICOMCOD3 E , ICOMCOD3 F WHERE E.BUYER = A.BUYER AND E.CODE1 = #{st_user_dept} AND E.TYPE = 'DTOD' AND E.BUYER = F.BUYER AND E.CODE2 = F.CODE1 AND F.TYPE = 'DTOA' AND F.CODE1 = DECODE(A.BUDGET_DEPT,NULL,#{st_user_dept}, A.BUDGET_DEPT ) AND DECODE(F.FLAG,'Y',DECODE(#{st_user_dept},F.CODE1,'N','Y'),'N') = 'N' AND F.CODE2 = DECODE(A.ACCOUNT_TYPE,NULL,B.ACCOUNT_TYPE, A.ACCOUNT_TYPE ))) ) FROM ICOMCOD3 E , ICOMCOD3 F WHERE E.BUYER = A.BUYER AND E.CODE1 = #{st_user_dept} AND E.TYPE = 'DTOD' AND E.BUYER = F.BUYER AND E.CODE2 = F.CODE1 AND F.TYPE = 'DTOA' AND F.CODE2 = DECODE(A.ACCOUNT_TYPE,NULL,B.ACCOUNT_TYPE, A.ACCOUNT_TYPE ) ) BUDGET_DEPT_CODE,
(select DECODE(COUNT(*),0 , '', 1 , DECODE(DECODE(A.BUDGET_DEPT,NULL,#{st_user_dept}, A.BUDGET_DEPT ),MAX(F.CODE1), MAX((SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 T WHERE T.COMPANY_CODE = A.BUYER AND T.TYPE = 'C001' AND T.CODE = F.CODE1)) ,''), MAX((SELECT MAX((SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 T WHERE T.COMPANY_CODE = A.BUYER AND T.TYPE = 'C001' AND T.CODE = F.CODE1)) FROM ICOMCOD3 E , ICOMCOD3 F WHERE E.BUYER = A.BUYER AND E.CODE1 = #{st_user_dept} AND E.TYPE = 'DTOD' AND E.BUYER = F.BUYER AND E.CODE2 = F.CODE1 AND F.TYPE = 'DTOA' AND F.CODE1 = DECODE(A.BUDGET_DEPT,NULL,#{st_user_dept}, A.BUDGET_DEPT ) AND DECODE(F.FLAG,'Y',DECODE(#{st_user_dept},F.CODE1,'N','Y'),'N') = 'N' AND F.CODE2 = DECODE(A.ACCOUNT_TYPE,NULL,B.ACCOUNT_TYPE, A.ACCOUNT_TYPE ))) ) FROM ICOMCOD3 E , ICOMCOD3 F WHERE E.BUYER = A.BUYER AND E.CODE1 = #{st_user_dept} AND E.TYPE = 'DTOD' AND E.BUYER = F.BUYER AND E.CODE2 = F.CODE1 AND F.TYPE = 'DTOA' AND F.CODE2 = DECODE(A.ACCOUNT_TYPE,NULL,B.ACCOUNT_TYPE, A.ACCOUNT_TYPE ) ) BUDGET_DEPT_NAME,
NVL(TRIM(B.OVER_SHORT_FLAG),'N') AS OVER_SHORT_FLAG, TRIM(B.HS_NO) AS HS_NO, B.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG AS PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG, NVL(A.REMARK,' ') REMARK
,C.PROCESS_TYPE ,DECODE( C.PROCESS_TYPE,'1' , (SELECT DECODE(COUNT(*),0,'N','Y') FROM ICOMBYIT IT, ICOMCOD1 D WHERE D.TYPE ='HUB' AND D.CODE = C.AGENT AND D.TEXT1 = IT.BUYER AND IT.BUYER_ITEM_NO = B.CMS_CATLG_ID AND IT.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG ='N') , 'Y' ) AS STOCK_ITEM_FLAG ,A.HI_DEPT_CODE ,DECODE(B.STATUS||C.STATUS,'CC','거래','CR','거래','RC','거래','RR','거래','DC','삭제','DR','삭제','DD','삭제','CD','삭제','RD','삭제','거래') AS ITEM_STATUS_FLAG FROM ICOMCART A, ICOMBYIT B, ICOMCQDT C WHERE B.BUYER = C.BUYER AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = B.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = C.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND A.CONTRACT_NO = C.CONTRACT_NO AND A.CONTRACT_SEQ = C.CONTRACT_SEQ AND A.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND A.BYIT_COMORG_CODE = B.BUYER AND A.USER_ID = #{st_user_id} AND A.USE_FLAG = 'C'
AND B.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG IN ('N','Y')
ORDER BY 1,2,3 ) Y ) Z

FROM (SELECT ROWNUM NUM, Y.IMGFILE_NAME, Y.IMGFILE_DIR, Y.BUYER_ITEM_NO, Y.DESCRIPTION_LOC, Y.SPECIFICATION, Y.ORIGIN_NAME, Y.MAKER_NAME, Y.UNIT_MEASURE, Y.TARGET_PRICE, Y.CATEGORY_NO, Y.AGENT, Y.CART_QTY, Y.TOT_SUM, Y.STDCATEG_ID, Y.CONTRACT_NO, Y.CONTRACT_SEQ, Y.BYIT_COMORG_CODE, Y.REF_PR_NO, Y.AGENT_CODE, Y.BDGT_FLAG, Y.ACCOUNT_TYPE, Y.FIXED_PRICE_FLAG, Y.ACCOUNT_NAME, Y.BUDGET_DEPT_CODE, Y.BUDGET_DEPT_NAME, Y.OVER_SHORT_FLAG, Y.HS_NO, Y.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG, Y.REMARK, Y.PROCESS_TYPE , Y.STOCK_ITEM_FLAG ,Y.HI_DEPT_CODE
FROM ( SELECT

(SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE COMPANY_CODE = A.BUYER AND TYPE = 'Z014' AND CODE = DECODE(A.ACCOUNT_TYPE,NULL,B.ACCOUNT_TYPE,A.ACCOUNT_TYPE)) AS ACCOUNT_NAME,
(select DECODE(COUNT(*),0 , '', 1 , DECODE(DECODE(A.BUDGET_DEPT,NULL,#{st_user_dept} , A.BUDGET_DEPT ),MAX(F.CODE1),MAX(F.CODE1),''), MAX((SELECT F.CODE1 FROM ICOMCOD3 E , ICOMCOD3 F WHERE E.BUYER = A.BUYER AND E.CODE1 = #{st_user_dept} AND E.TYPE = 'DTOD' AND E.BUYER = F.BUYER AND E.CODE2 = F.CODE1 AND F.TYPE = 'DTOA' AND F.CODE1 = DECODE(A.BUDGET_DEPT,NULL,#{st_user_dept} , A.BUDGET_DEPT ) AND DECODE(F.FLAG,'Y',DECODE(#{st_user_dept} ,F.CODE1,'N','Y'),'N') = 'N' AND F.CODE2 = DECODE(A.ACCOUNT_TYPE,NULL,B.ACCOUNT_TYPE, A.ACCOUNT_TYPE ))) ) FROM ICOMCOD3 E , ICOMCOD3 F WHERE E.BUYER = A.BUYER AND E.CODE1 = #{st_user_dept} AND E.TYPE = 'DTOD' AND E.BUYER = F.BUYER AND E.CODE2 = F.CODE1 AND F.TYPE = 'DTOA' AND F.CODE2 = DECODE(A.ACCOUNT_TYPE,NULL,B.ACCOUNT_TYPE, A.ACCOUNT_TYPE ) ) BUDGET_DEPT_CODE,
